These are original synthetic protocol examples for the configured Claude adapter.
They contain invented models, identifiers and content, not vendor transcripts or
private account data. Neither a matching CLI version in tests nor a passing
decoder test qualifies installed Claude, Anthropic, Ollama, routing, tool/context
enforcement, effort, usage, remote cancellation or process cessation.

One shared decoder handles both explicitly configured backends. The public sample
binds a complete proposal to the declared bundle/session. No sample is a receipt,
permission, production activation, billing settlement or independent acceptance.
